description: Given a subgraph SDL that violates a federation composition rule, the transformation fails and the failure is surfaced as a neutral, language-independent error category line rather than a schema. Distinct categories distinguish: importing the federation specification at a version that is not supported, declaring the federation import link more than once, importing a feature from a specification version that predates it, attempting to rename a directive that may not be renamed, an entity that fails to declare the key required by an interface it implements, and generic schema-construction or schema-validation failures.
